title: Storage Multi-Root Archive Contract, Operational Truth, Activation Reliability and Frontend Evidence Closeout
summary: Closes the accepted Stage 13.5 Storage multi-root archive cycle: root-aware storage, playback and timeline access across active and inactive roots; reliable activation with lease, rollback and recovery safety; truthful NAS volume discovery and operator status; stable System Status behavior under retryable failures; and final frontend evidence hardening.
changelog: Makes recording identity root-aware across Records, Chronology, media tokens, playback, downloads, exports and deletes, including duplicate relative paths.
Keeps archive history readable from active and inactive roots and preserves a continuous camera timeline across root switches.
Aggregates archive capacity truth by physical NAS volume while preserving per-root usage, file counts, availability and configured path evidence.
Introduces live NAS volume discovery with snapshot and candidate validation, rejecting stale, synthetic or changed selections before root creation.
Hardens archive-root activation with operation ownership, leases, heartbeats, stale-worker fencing, verified rollback and resumable recovery.
Stops only cameras recording at activation time, waits for confirmed stop, applies the runtime root and restores only the captured camera set.
Keeps root add, activation, deletion, retention, reconciliation, migration, exports and bulk actions bound to stable root identity and fail-closed checks.
Presents truthful activation progress, recovery state, volume capacity, root access and archive problems without fabricated completion or raw service text.
Keeps the Storage add-root layout compact with one header status and no lower refreshing, stale or unavailable text that changes disclosure height.
Fixes System Status retry classification so 5xx and network failures remain retryable and only 401/403 or exact permission messages hide the slot.
Aligns stale frontend tests with accepted Archive Export, timezone formatting and root-aware playback contracts; the full frontend corpus is green.
